title: ReVamp (Digital Sun) moves its first playtest from Steam to Discord over AI cloning fears; public playtest around January; release 25 Mar 2027 unchanged

sources.name: Digital Sun, Steam announcement 'About the ReVamp playtest' (DigitalMallen)
sources.via: Steam news API, read 05:58Z and at the gate 06:21Z

sources.name: PC Gamer (quotes marketing manager Israel Mallén)

claims.text: First playtest moves from Steam to Digital Sun's Discord, access in waves; still starts 29 Oct
Reason: games being reverse-engineered, cloned and published before the original is out; sharing a build with tens of thousands felt like too big a risk
Public playtest hoped for around January; platforms urged to strengthen protections

media.kind: the game's own trailer with its narration from 9.5 s; blood-red stretches left out; lowres_ok for one 952-row shot

notes: Grammar review: no required edits after the X text was softened ('hopes to open around January', not 'postponed to January'). DeepL back-check matches; forward pass gave الهندسة العكسية for reverse-engineered, taken into the caption quote.
